description: ballSwivel 30 turns +30 about up through the toe pivot. Offset (dx 0, dz -1.8): x' = -1.8 sin30 = -0.9, z' = -1.8 cos30 = -1.558846. The toe pivot is the toe joint (4, 3.3, 1.8), so the hand at (4, 4, 0) is offset (dy 0.7, dz -1.8) from it, the toe bone's length 1.931321, and it keeps that length to the planted toe. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target.
